evidence.title: Claroc reports enumerating over 6,800 share hostnames through one passive-DNS dataset, checking only hundreds of pages.
evidence.observation: Claroc reports enumerating over 6,800 share hostnames through one passive-DNS dataset, checking only hundreds of pages. An October 20 recheck found all 40 previously accessible sampled shares unavailable, while historical hostnames remained discoverable.

source_locations.SRC-106: Scale; Method and limits; October 20 update

evidence.limitations: Most sampled content was innocuous; no evidence of misuse. One provider and one naming pattern cannot measure total exposure. DNS observation requires provider visibility; not every lookup enters a universal public log. Hostname persistence is not current content access. No affected links or personal data retained.
evidence.open_questions: Underlying evidence has not been authenticated or reproduced by the Commons; generalizability remains unestablished.
evidence.support_assessment: Attributed bounded finding; publication inclusion does not certify truth or completeness. No baseline source or case match found; repeated reporting is not independent corroboration.

terms.name: Assurance
terms.definition: Evidence-supported confidence that specified properties or outcomes will hold under stated objectives, operating conditions, and assumptions. Assurance has a defined scope and can lose relevance when those conditions change.

terms.name: Observability
terms.definition: The capacity to obtain and interpret dependable evidence about states, actions, relationships, and consequences relevant to a specified question. Evidence may come from more than one system or organization.

terms.name: Operational trust
terms.definition: Reliance placed in an AI-enabled capability through actual use, decisions, and delegation, whether or not users express subjective confidence in it. Trust in this sense is operational behavior, not a reliability certification.
